The relative (natural) gradient, equivariance, local stability of the separating solutions, and the Infomax and extended Infomax algorithms.

First pass第一次读这一章

One sentence. The natural-gradient update uses the current outputs to decide how to adjust the current unmixing matrix, while the step size controls how far it moves.

一句话直觉。自然梯度根据当前输出，决定怎样调整当前分离矩阵；步长决定这次调整走多远。

By the end, you should be able to:

读完后，你应能：

  • compute one two-channel update from a supplied sample-average matrix;
  • distinguish a small step from a small estimating-equation residual;
  • explain why a stable local solution is not a global convergence guarantee.
  • 从给定的样本平均矩阵算出一次双通道更新；
  • 区分“走了一小步”与“估计方程的残差很小”；
  • 解释为什么局部稳定的解不代表全局收敛保证。

Route. Start with the likelihood and score and the matrix notation. Read the update, step sizes and stopping safeguards. The geometric derivation and stability proof can be second-pass reading; do retain their conditions.

路线。先看似然与得分函数以及矩阵记号。先读更新规则、步长与停止保护。几何推导和稳定性证明可放到第二遍，但要保留它们的适用条件。

Quick check 1. If μ=0\mu=0μ=0, has an unchanged matrix proved convergence?

自测 1。若令 μ=0\mu=0μ=0，矩阵不再变化，是否就证明收敛了？

No. The update is zero by choice, while ∥H∥F=0.22+0.12≈0.224\|\bH\|_F=\sqrt{0.2^2+0.1^2}\approx0.224∥H∥F​=0.22+0.12​≈0.224 remains nonzero. A small increment must be interpreted alongside the residual.

Quick check 2. Can this same average matrix be reused indefinitely?

自测 2。能否一直重复使用刚才这个平均矩阵？

No. It was computed from the old outputs. Changing the unmixing changes the outputs, their nonlinearities and the average. Reusing it no longer implements the stated algorithm.

不能。它由旧输出计算而来。分离矩阵变化后，输出、输出的非线性函数值及其平均都会变化；一直复用它就不再是所述算法。

7.1 From a contrast to an update rule从对比函数到更新规则

Chapter 6第 6 章 reduced ICA to an optimization problem: find the unmixing matrix W\bWW that maximizes the log-likelihood (6.1), or to minimize the mutual information of the outputs. These objectives share separating optima under a correct source model, but a fixed misspecified likelihood also contains marginal mismatch and is not generally equivalent to mutual-information minimization. This chapter turns that problem into algorithms that adjust W\bWW step by step. Three questions run through it. In which direction should W\bWW move? How does the behaviour of the algorithm depend on the unknown mixing matrix A\bAA? And which solutions are attractors, so that the algorithm actually settles on them?

Chapter 6第 6 章把 ICA 归结为一个优化问题：寻找使对数似然 (6.1) 最大的解混矩阵 W\bWW，或者使输出的互信息最小。源模型正确时，它们共享分离的最优解；但固定的失配似然还包含边缘失配项，通常不等价于互信息最小化。本章把这个问题变成逐步调整 W\bWW 的算法。贯穿全章的有三个问题：W\bWW 应当沿什么方向移动？算法的行为如何依赖于未知的混合矩阵 A\bAA？哪些解是吸引子，也就是说，算法实际会停在哪些解上？

The answers are, in order: along the relative or natural gradient, which needs no matrix inversion; not at all, a property called equivariance; and the separating solutions attract the algorithm when a simple condition linking the nonlinearity to the source distributions holds, and not when it fails. The same condition explains why the original Infomax algorithm separates typical super-Gaussian sources such as speech but fails on some sub-Gaussian ones, and how the extended version repairs this.

三个答案依次是：沿着相对梯度（即自然梯度）的方向移动，这一方向不需要矩阵求逆；完全不依赖，这一性质称为等变性；当非线性函数与源分布之间满足一个简单的条件时，分离解吸引算法，条件不满足时则不然。同一个条件解释了为什么原始的 Infomax 算法能分离语音这类常见的超高斯源，却在某些亚高斯源上失效，以及扩展 Infomax 如何弥补这一缺陷。

Throughout the chapter the model is square (m=nm = nm=n, after the PCA reduction of Section 3.6第 3.6 节 if necessary), A\bAA is invertible, and the sources are independent with zero mean. The algorithms use model densities pip_ipi​ that need not be the true ones. Their scores φi=−pi′/pi\varphi_i = -p_i'/p_iφi​=−pi′​/pi​ are the nonlinearities of the algorithm, collected in φ(y)=(φ1(y1),…,φn(yn))⊤\bphi(\by) = (\varphi_1(y_1), \dots, \varphi_n(y_n))^\topφ(y)=(φ1​(y1​),…,φn​(yn​))⊤. When the model is right, φi\varphi_iφi​ is the true score ψi\psi_iψi​ of Definition 6.1定义 6.1.

本章始终假设模型是方阵情形（m=nm = nm=n，必要时先做Section 3.6第 3.6 节的 PCA 降维），A\bAA 可逆，各源相互独立且均值为零。算法使用的是模型密度 pip_ipi​，它不必是真实密度。模型密度的得分函数 φi=−pi′/pi\varphi_i = -p_i'/p_iφi​=−pi′​/pi​ 就是算法中的非线性函数，记作向量 φ(y)=(φ1(y1),…,φn(yn))⊤\bphi(\by) = (\varphi_1(y_1), \dots, \varphi_n(y_n))^\topφ(y)=(φ1​(y1​),…,φn​(yn​))⊤。模型正确时，φi\varphi_iφi​ 就是Definition 6.1定义 6.1中的真实得分函数 ψi\psi_iψi​。

ℓ(W)=E[∑i=1nlog⁡pi(yi)]+log⁡∣det⁡W∣,y=Wx,(7.1)\ell(\bW) = \E\Bigl[\sum_{i=1}^n \log p_i(y_i)\Bigr] + \log|\det\bW|, \qquad \by = \bW\bx,\tag{7.1}ℓ(W)=E[i=1∑n​logpi​(yi​)]+log∣detW∣,y=Wx,(7.1)

is the objective of this chapter. 就是本章的目标函数。批量算法把 E\EE 换成对 x(1),…,x(T)\bx(1), \dots, \bx(T)x(1),…,x(T) 的样本平均 E^\hat\EE^，此时 ℓ\ellℓ 就是 1Tlog⁡L(W)\frac1T\log L(\bW)T1​logL(W)。由 ∂log⁡∣det⁡W∣/∂W=W−⊤\partial\log|\det\bW|/\partial\bW = \bW^{-\top}∂log∣detW∣/∂W=W−⊤（Section A.6第 A.6 节）以及 ∂log⁡pi(wi⊤x)/∂wi=−φi(yi) x\partial\log p_i(\bw_i^\top\bx)/\partial\bw_i = -\varphi_i(y_i)\,\bx∂logpi​(wi⊤​x)/∂wi​=−φi​(yi​)x，梯度为

∇ℓ(W)=W−⊤−E[φ(y) x⊤].(7.2)\nabla\ell(\bW) = \bW^{-\top} - \E\bigl[\bphi(\by)\,\bx^\top\bigr].\tag{7.2}∇ℓ(W)=W−⊤−E[φ(y)x⊤].(7.2)

Setting the gradient to zero and multiplying on the right by W⊤\bW^\topW⊤ gives the estimating equations E[φ(y)y⊤]=I\E[\bphi(\by)\by^\top] = \bIE[φ(y)y⊤]=I, that is, E[φi(yi) yj]=δij\E[\varphi_i(y_i)\,y_j] = \delta_{ij}E[φi​(yi​)yj​]=δij​ for all i,ji, ji,j. Every separating matrix satisfies the off-diagonal equations, whatever the nonlinearities: if yiy_iyi​ and yjy_jyj​ are multiples of two different sources, then E[φi(yi)yj]=E[φi(yi)] E[yj]=0\E[\varphi_i(y_i)y_j] = \E[\varphi_i(y_i)]\,\E[y_j] = 0E[φi​(yi​)yj​]=E[φi​(yi​)]E[yj​]=0 by independence and zero means. The diagonal equations only fix the scale of each output. This is the robustness to a wrong source model noted in Chapter 6第 6 章: the model does not move the separating points. What it decides is whether an algorithm converges to them, the subject of Section 7.5第 7.5 节.

令梯度为零并右乘 W⊤\bW^\topW⊤，得到估计方程 E[φ(y)y⊤]=I\E[\bphi(\by)\by^\top] = \bIE[φ(y)y⊤]=I，即对所有 i,ji, ji,j 有 E[φi(yi) yj]=δij\E[\varphi_i(y_i)\,y_j] = \delta_{ij}E[φi​(yi​)yj​]=δij​。无论非线性函数取什么，任何分离矩阵都满足其中的非对角方程：若 yiy_iyi​ 与 yjy_jyj​ 分别是两个不同源的倍数，则由独立性与零均值，E[φi(yi)yj]=E[φi(yi)] E[yj]=0\E[\varphi_i(y_i)y_j] = \E[\varphi_i(y_i)]\,\E[y_j] = 0E[φi​(yi​)yj​]=E[φi​(yi​)]E[yj​]=0。对角方程只确定各输出的尺度。这正是Chapter 6第 6 章中提到的对源模型设错的稳健性：模型不会移动分离点，它决定的是算法能否收敛到分离点，这是Section 7.5第 7.5 节的主题。

Plain gradient ascent, W←W+μ∇ℓ(W)\bW \leftarrow \bW + \mu\nabla\ell(\bW)W←W+μ∇ℓ(W) with a step size μ>0\mu > 0μ>0, has two flaws. It needs the inverse W−⊤\bW^{-\top}W−⊤ at every step. More seriously, its behaviour depends on A\bAA. Write the update in terms of the global matrix P=WA\bP = \bW\bAP=WA, using W−⊤=P−⊤A⊤\bW^{-\top} = \bP^{-\top}\bA^\topW−⊤=P−⊤A⊤, x⊤=s⊤A⊤\bx^\top = \bs^\top\bA^\topx⊤=s⊤A⊤ and y=Ps\by = \bP\bsy=Ps:

普通的梯度上升 W←W+μ∇ℓ(W)\bW \leftarrow \bW + \mu\nabla\ell(\bW)W←W+μ∇ℓ(W)（步长 μ>0\mu > 0μ>0）有两个缺点。第一，每一步都要计算逆矩阵 W−⊤\bW^{-\top}W−⊤。第二，也是更严重的，它的行为依赖于 A\bAA。利用 W−⊤=P−⊤A⊤\bW^{-\top} = \bP^{-\top}\bA^\topW−⊤=P−⊤A⊤、x⊤=s⊤A⊤\bx^\top = \bs^\top\bA^\topx⊤=s⊤A⊤ 和 y=Ps\by = \bP\bsy=Ps，把更新改写成全局矩阵 P=WA\bP = \bW\bAP=WA 的形式：

P←P+μ(P−⊤−E[φ(y) s⊤]) A⊤A.(7.3)\bP \leftarrow \bP + \mu\bigl(\bP^{-\top} - \E[\bphi(\by)\,\bs^\top]\bigr)\,\bA^\top\bA.\tag{7.3}P←P+μ(P−⊤−E[φ(y)s⊤])A⊤A.(7.3)

The fixed matrix A⊤A\bA^\top\bAA⊤A acts as a preconditioner chosen by nature. When A\bAA is ill-conditioned, the steps are long in some directions and very short in others, and no single step size suits all of them. Panel (a) of Figure 7.1图 7.1 shows the effect: with a condition number of 10, plain gradient ascent hardly moves in 150 iterations.

固定矩阵 A⊤A\bA^\top\bAA⊤A 相当于一个由“自然”指定的预条件矩阵。A\bAA 病态时，更新在某些方向上步子很大，在另一些方向上步子极小，没有一个统一的步长能同时适合所有方向。Figure 7.1图 7.1的（a）图显示了这一效应：条件数为 10 时，普通梯度上升在 150 次迭代中几乎原地不动。

7.3 Relative and natural gradients相对梯度与自然梯度

Before the geometry. Read ΔW=μHW\Delta\bW=\mu\bH\bWΔW=μHW as “a small correction in the present output coordinates.” The rightmost W\bWW converts that correction back to a sensor-to-output map. You can use and check this matrix multiplication before studying the right-invariant metric below.

先理解操作，再看几何。把 ΔW=μHW\Delta\bW=\mu\bH\bWΔW=μHW 读成“在当前输出坐标里作一个小修正”。最右边的 W\bWW 把修正接回从传感器到输出的映射。可以先会算、会核对这个矩阵乘法，再研究下面的右不变度量。

Cardoso and Laheld (1996) perturb W\bWW multiplicatively, W→(I+ε)W\bW \to (\bI + \bepsilon)\bWW→(I+ε)W with a small n×nn \times nn×n matrix ε\bepsilonε, so that the outputs change by y→y+εy\by \to \by + \bepsilon\byy→y+εy. To first order, log⁡∣det⁡((I+ε)W)∣=log⁡∣det⁡W∣+tr⁡ε\log|\det((\bI + \bepsilon)\bW)| = \log|\det\bW| + \tr\bepsilonlog∣det((I+ε)W)∣=log∣detW∣+trε and log⁡pi(yi+(εy)i)=log⁡pi(yi)−φi(yi)∑jεijyj\log p_i\bigl(y_i + (\bepsilon\by)_i\bigr) = \log p_i(y_i) - \varphi_i(y_i)\sum_j \varepsilon_{ij}y_jlogpi​(yi​+(εy)i​)=logpi​(yi​)−φi​(yi​)∑j​εij​yj​. Hence

Cardoso 与 Laheld（1996）对 W\bWW 做乘性扰动 W→(I+ε)W\bW \to (\bI + \bepsilon)\bWW→(I+ε)W，其中 ε\bepsilonε 是一个小的 n×nn \times nn×n 矩阵，于是输出变为 y→y+εy\by \to \by + \bepsilon\byy→y+εy。在一阶近似下，log⁡∣det⁡((I+ε)W)∣=log⁡∣det⁡W∣+tr⁡ε\log|\det((\bI + \bepsilon)\bW)| = \log|\det\bW| + \tr\bepsilonlog∣det((I+ε)W)∣=log∣detW∣+trε，且 log⁡pi(yi+(εy)i)=log⁡pi(yi)−φi(yi)∑jεijyj\log p_i\bigl(y_i + (\bepsilon\by)_i\bigr) = \log p_i(y_i) - \varphi_i(y_i)\sum_j \varepsilon_{ij}y_jlogpi​(yi​+(εy)i​)=logpi​(yi​)−φi​(yi​)∑j​εij​yj​。因此

ℓ((I+ε)W)=ℓ(W)+⟨I−E[φ(y)y⊤], ε⟩+o(∥ε∥),(7.4)\ell\bigl((\bI + \bepsilon)\bW\bigr) = \ell(\bW) + \bigl\langle \bI - \E[\bphi(\by)\by^\top],\ \bepsilon \bigr\rangle + o(\|\bepsilon\|),\tag{7.4}ℓ((I+ε)W)=ℓ(W)+⟨I−E[φ(y)y⊤], ε⟩+o(∥ε∥),(7.4)

The algorithm sees only the sources and its current global matrix. The speed of convergence, the attained accuracy and the stability of each separating point are the same for every invertible A\bAA; they are properties of the source distributions, the nonlinearities, the step sizes and the starting point P0\bP_0P0​. Cardoso and Laheld (1996) call algorithms with this property equivariant. (7.3) shows that plain gradient ascent is not equivariant. Figure 7.1图 7.1(a) compares the two on the same sources, started from the same P0\bP_0P0​, for three mixing matrices with condition numbers 1, 10 and 100: the three natural-gradient curves coincide, while the ordinary gradient slows down with the conditioning.

算法“看到”的只有源和它当前的全局矩阵。收敛速度、所达到的精度以及各分离点的稳定性，对每个可逆的 A\bAA 都一样；它们只取决于源分布、非线性函数、步长以及起点 P0\bP_0P0​。Cardoso 与 Laheld（1996）把具有这一性质的算法称为等变算法。由 (7.3) 可见，普通梯度上升不是等变的。Figure 7.1图 7.1（a）在同一组源上、从同一个 P0\bP_0P0​ 出发，对条件数分别为 1、10、100 的三个混合矩阵比较了两种算法：三条自然梯度曲线完全重合，而普通梯度随条件数变差而变慢。

Two caveats. Equivariance is a property of the noiseless model: with x=As+n\bx = \bA\bs + \bnx=As+n the outputs are Ps+Wn\bP\bs + \bW\bnPs+Wn, and the noise term depends on W\bWW and hence on A\bAA (Section 11.2第 11.2 节). And it says nothing about the starting point: with W0=I\bW_0 = \bIW0​=I the algorithm starts at P0=A\bP_0 = \bAP0​=A, which is far from separation when A\bAA is ill-conditioned. Whitening first starts it at the orthogonal matrix P0=A~\bP_0 = \tilde\bAP0​=A~ instead, which is one good reason to whiten the data before iterating. Because performance does not depend on A\bAA, the statistical analysis of Chapter 10第 10 章 can assume A=I\bA = \bIA=I without loss of generality.

有两点需要注意。其一，等变性只对无噪声模型成立：若 x=As+n\bx = \bA\bs + \bnx=As+n，输出为 Ps+Wn\bP\bs + \bW\bnPs+Wn，噪声项依赖于 W\bWW，从而依赖于 A\bAA（Section 11.2第 11.2 节）。其二，等变性不涉及起点：取 W0=I\bW_0 = \bIW0​=I 时，算法从 P0=A\bP_0 = \bAP0​=A 出发，A\bAA 病态时这个起点离分离很远。先做白化，起点就变成正交矩阵 P0=A~\bP_0 = \tilde\bAP0​=A~，这是迭代之前先白化数据的一个充分理由。由于性能与 A\bAA 无关，Chapter 10第 10 章的统计分析可以不失一般性地假设 A=I\bA = \bIA=I。

The 2×22 \times 22×2 matrix is symmetric, so its eigenvalues are real, and the pair is stable exactly when the matrix is positive definite: positive diagonal entries and determinant σi2σj2kikj−1>0\sigma_i^2\sigma_j^2k_ik_j - 1 > 0σi2​σj2​ki​kj​−1>0. Conversely, a negative diagonal entry or a negative determinant produces a negative eigenvalue of the matrix, that is, a growing mode. The linearization thus has only negative eigenvalues under (i)–(iii) and a positive one under any of the reversed inequalities; Lyapunov's linearization theorem gives both claims.

The following script implements batch natural-gradient ICA and runs it from W0=I\bW_0 = \bIW0​=I on two uniform and on two Laplace sources, with φ=tanh⁡\varphi = \tanhφ=tanh, with φ(y)=y3\varphi(y) = y^3φ(y)=y3, and with the extended Infomax rule of Section 7.7第 7.7 节. The printed interference is the largest ratio, over the rows of P=WA\bP = \bW\bAP=WA, of the second-largest to the largest entry in absolute value; it is 0 for perfect separation and near 1 for an even mixture.

下面的脚本实现了批量自然梯度 ICA，并从 W0=I\bW_0 = \bIW0​=I 出发，分别在两个均匀源和两个拉普拉斯源上运行，非线性函数依次取 φ=tanh⁡\varphi = \tanhφ=tanh、φ(y)=y3\varphi(y) = y^3φ(y)=y3 以及Section 7.7第 7.7 节的扩展 Infomax 规则。打印的干扰值是：在 P=WA\bP = \bW\bAP=WA 的各行中，绝对值第二大的元素与最大元素之比的最大值；完全分离时为 0，均匀混合时接近 1。

This controlled demonstration uses a fixed budget of 500 full-batch updates and reports residual mixing; returning a matrix is not a convergence certificate. The extended variant keeps its preceding sign when the switching statistic lies within 10−610^{-6}10−6 of zero. For deployment, apply the residual, step-size and failure checks discussed later in this chapter.

这个受控演示固定运行 500 次全批量更新，并报告残余混合；返回矩阵并不构成收敛证明。扩展算法在切换统计量与零的距离不超过 10−610^{-6}10−6 时保留上一次符号。实际使用时，应实施本章后述的残差、步长与失败检查。

import numpy as np

def natural_gradient_ica(X, phi, mu=0.1, iters=500):
    """Batch natural-gradient ICA: W <- W + mu (I - E[phi(y) y^T]) W."""
    n, T = X.shape
    W = np.eye(n)
    for _ in range(iters):
        Y = W @ X
        W += mu * (np.eye(n) - phi(Y) @ Y.T / T) @ W
    return W

def extended_infomax(X, mu=0.1, iters=500):
    """phi_i(y) = y + k_i tanh(y), k_i = +1 or -1 set by the switching rule."""
    n, T = X.shape
    W = np.eye(n)
    k = np.ones(n)  # retain the previous sign when the statistic is near zero
    for _ in range(iters):
        Y = W @ X
        stat = (np.mean(1 - np.tanh(Y) ** 2, axis=1) * np.mean(Y ** 2, axis=1)
                - np.mean(np.tanh(Y) * Y, axis=1))
        k = np.where(stat > 1e-6, 1, np.where(stat < -1e-6, -1, k))
        W += mu * (np.eye(n) - (Y + k[:, None] * np.tanh(Y)) @ Y.T / T) @ W
    return W

def interference(P):
    """Max over rows of P of second-largest / largest |entry|; 0 = separated."""
    R = np.sort(np.abs(P), axis=1)
    return np.max(R[:, -2] / R[:, -1])

rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
T = 20000
A = np.array([[1.0, 0.6],
              [0.4, 1.0]])
sources = {"uniform": rng.uniform(-np.sqrt(3), np.sqrt(3), (2, T)),   # kappa = -1.2
           "Laplace": rng.laplace(0, 1 / np.sqrt(2), (2, T))}        # kappa = +3
methods = {"tanh": lambda X: natural_gradient_ica(X, np.tanh),
           "cube": lambda X: natural_gradient_ica(X, lambda y: y ** 3),
           "extended": extended_infomax}
for sname, S in sources.items():
    for mname, method in methods.items():
        W = method(A @ S)
        print(f"{sname:8s} {mname:9s} interference = {interference(W @ A):.3f}")

uniform  tanh      interference = 0.987
uniform  cube      interference = 0.010
uniform  extended  interference = 0.012
Laplace  tanh      interference = 0.004
Laplace  cube      interference = 0.943
Laplace  extended  interference = 0.005

exactly the pattern of Table 7.1表 7.1: tanh⁡\tanhtanh fails on the uniform pair and y3y^3y3 on the Laplace pair, where they converge to points whose outputs are roughly even mixtures of the two sources, while each succeeds on the other pair. The residual interference of about 0.01 for the successful runs is estimation error from the finite sample (Chapter 10第 10 章). Figure 7.1图 7.1(b) shows the same dichotomy as a dynamical statement: started next to the separating point, the mismatched runs move away from it.

这恰好是Table 7.1表 7.1所预言的模式：tanh⁡\tanhtanh 在均匀源对上失败，y3y^3y3 在拉普拉斯源对上失败，它们收敛到的点的输出大致是两个源的均匀混合；而各自在另一对源上都成功。成功运行中约 0.01 的残余干扰是有限样本带来的估计误差（Chapter 10第 10 章）。Figure 7.1图 7.1（b）以动力学的语言展示了同一个二分现象：从分离点附近出发，不匹配的运行会离开分离点。

7.6 InfomaxInfomax 算法

Bell and Sejnowski (1995) arrived at the same family of algorithms from a different principle. Pass the outputs yi=wi⊤xy_i = \bw_i^\top\bxyi​=wi⊤​x through the logistic function g(y)=1/(1+e−y)g(y) = 1/(1 + e^{-y})g(y)=1/(1+e−y) and choose W\bWW to maximize the joint entropy of u=(g(y1),…,g(yn))⊤\bu = (g(y_1), \dots, g(y_n))^\topu=(g(y1​),…,g(yn​))⊤, an output-entropy criterion motivated by information transmission with small output noise. For a deterministic continuous invertible map the input–output mutual information is generally infinite; the finite objective here is the output entropy, as explained in Section 6.5第 6.5 节. Since ggg is increasing and y=Wx\by = \bW\bxy=Wx, the change-of-variables formula and Proposition 2.13命题 2.13 give

Bell 与 Sejnowski（1995）从另一个原理出发得到了同一族算法。把输出 yi=wi⊤xy_i = \bw_i^\top\bxyi​=wi⊤​x 通过 logistic 函数 g(y)=1/(1+e−y)g(y) = 1/(1 + e^{-y})g(y)=1/(1+e−y)，再选取 W\bWW 使 u=(g(y1),…,g(yn))⊤\bu = (g(y_1), \dots, g(y_n))^\topu=(g(y1​),…,g(yn​))⊤ 的联合熵最大，这是由小输出噪声下的信息传输所启发的输出熵准则。对确定性连续可逆映射，输入与输出的互信息通常为无穷大；这里的有限目标是输出熵，详见Section 6.5第 6.5 节。由于 ggg 单调递增且 y=Wx\by = \bW\bxy=Wx，由变量替换公式和Proposition 2.13命题 2.13得

H(u)=H(x)+log⁡∣det⁡W∣+∑i=1nE[log⁡g′(yi)].H(\bu) = H(\bx) + \log|\det\bW| + \sum_{i=1}^n \E\bigl[\log g'(y_i)\bigr].H(u)=H(x)+log∣detW∣+i=1∑n​E[logg′(yi​)].

Up to the constant H(x)H(\bx)H(x) this is the objective ℓ(W)\ell(\bW)ℓ(W) of (7.1) with model densities pi=g′p_i = g'pi​=g′, the logistic density: Infomax is maximum likelihood with a logistic source model (Cardoso, 1997; Proposition 6.5命题 6.5). Since g′=g(1−g)g' = g(1 - g)g′=g(1−g), the score of this model is φ(y)=2g(y)−1=tanh⁡(y/2)\varphi(y) = 2g(y) - 1 = \tanh(y/2)φ(y)=2g(y)−1=tanh(y/2) (Exercise 7.1习题 7.1). Bell and Sejnowski's gradient is ∇H(u)=W−⊤+E[(1−2g(y))x⊤]\nabla H(\bu) = \bW^{-\top} + \E[(\mathbf{1} - 2\mathbf{g}(\by))\bx^\top]∇H(u)=W−⊤+E[(1−2g(y))x⊤], where 1\mathbf{1}1 is the vector of ones and g\mathbf{g}g acts componentwise; this is (7.2) with φ=2g−1\bphi = 2\mathbf{g} - \mathbf{1}φ=2g−1. They also adapt a bias w0\bw_0w0​ in y=Wx+w0\by = \bW\bx + \bw_0y=Wx+w0​, which we omit for centered data. In practice the algorithm is usually run in its natural-gradient form.

除去常数 H(x)H(\bx)H(x)，这正是 (7.1) 中的目标函数 ℓ(W)\ell(\bW)ℓ(W)，其模型密度为 pi=g′p_i = g'pi​=g′，即 logistic 密度：Infomax 就是以 logistic 分布为源模型的最大似然（Cardoso, 1997；Proposition 6.5命题 6.5）。由于 g′=g(1−g)g' = g(1 - g)g′=g(1−g)，这一模型的得分函数为 φ(y)=2g(y)−1=tanh⁡(y/2)\varphi(y) = 2g(y) - 1 = \tanh(y/2)φ(y)=2g(y)−1=tanh(y/2)（Exercise 7.1习题 7.1）。Bell 与 Sejnowski 给出的梯度是 ∇H(u)=W−⊤+E[(1−2g(y))x⊤]\nabla H(\bu) = \bW^{-\top} + \E[(\mathbf{1} - 2\mathbf{g}(\by))\bx^\top]∇H(u)=W−⊤+E[(1−2g(y))x⊤]，其中 1\mathbf{1}1 是全 1 向量，g\mathbf{g}g 逐分量作用；这就是取 φ=2g−1\bphi = 2\mathbf{g} - \mathbf{1}φ=2g−1 时的 (7.2)。他们还在 y=Wx+w0\by = \bW\bx + \bw_0y=Wx+w0​ 中自适应调整偏置 w0\bw_0w0​；对已中心化的数据，这里略去偏置。实践中通常使用它的自然梯度形式。

Algorithm 7.4 (natural-gradient Infomax)算法 7.4（自然梯度 Infomax）

  1. Center the data; optionally whiten them, z=Vx\bz = \bV\bxz=Vx, so that the iteration starts from an orthogonal global matrix.
  2. Set W=I\bW = \bIW=I and choose a step size μ\muμ and a block size BBB (B=TB = TB=T gives the batch algorithm).
  3. For each block of BBB samples, compute y=Wx\by = \bW\bxy=Wx for the block and update W←W+μ(I−E^B[tanh⁡(y/2) y⊤])W\bW \leftarrow \bW + \mu\bigl(\bI - \hat\E_B[\tanh(\by/2)\,\by^\top]\bigr)\bWW←W+μ(I−E^B​[tanh(y/2)y⊤])W, where E^B\hat\E_BE^B​ averages over the block.
  4. After each pass through the data, reduce μ\muμ if the change of W\bWW has grown; stop when the change falls below a tolerance.
  5. Return W\bWW (or WV\bW\bVWV if the data were whitened).
  1. 中心化数据；可以选择先白化 z=Vx\bz = \bV\bxz=Vx，使迭代从正交的全局矩阵出发。
  2. 令 W=I\bW = \bIW=I，选取步长 μ\muμ 与块大小 BBB（B=TB = TB=T 即批量算法）。
  3. 对每个含 BBB 个样本的数据块，计算该块的 y=Wx\by = \bW\bxy=Wx，并更新 W←W+μ(I−E^B[tanh⁡(y/2) y⊤])W\bW \leftarrow \bW + \mu\bigl(\bI - \hat\E_B[\tanh(\by/2)\,\by^\top]\bigr)\bWW←W+μ(I−E^B​[tanh(y/2)y⊤])W，其中 E^B\hat\E_BE^B​ 表示块内平均。
  4. 每遍历一次数据后，若 W\bWW 的变化量增大，就减小 μ\muμ；当变化量低于容差时停止。
  5. 返回 W\bWW（若数据已白化，返回 WV\bW\bVWV）。

The second row of Table 7.1表 7.1 describes this algorithm. Its separating points are stable for the usual super-Gaussian laws, such as the Laplace and logistic laws, consistent with the success of Infomax on speech and on many EEG and fMRI sources, which tend to be super-Gaussian. The exact criterion is γiγj>1\gamma_i\gamma_j > 1γi​γj​>1, not the sign of the kurtosis: a bimodal law with rare large values can have positive kurtosis and still γ<1\gamma < 1γ<1. A pair of uniform sources, with 0.8462≈0.72<10.846^2 \approx 0.72 < 10.8462≈0.72<1, is unstable: Infomax cannot separate two sub-Gaussian sources of this kind, however long it runs.

Table 7.1表 7.1的第二行描述的正是这个算法。对拉普拉斯、logistic 这类常见的超高斯分布，它的分离点是稳定的，这与 Infomax 在语音以及许多 EEG 和 fMRI 源上的成功相符，因为这些源往往是超高斯的。准确的判据是 γiγj>1\gamma_i\gamma_j > 1γi​γj​>1，而不是峭度的符号：一个带有罕见大值的双峰分布可以峭度为正，却仍有 γ<1\gamma < 1γ<1。一对均匀源满足 0.8462≈0.72<10.846^2 \approx 0.72 < 10.8462≈0.72<1，是不稳定的：无论运行多久，Infomax 都无法分离两个这类亚高斯源。

7.8 Step sizes, online learning and EASI步长、在线学习与 EASI

Batch iteration. With a constant step size, (7.5) is a fixed-point iteration whose linearization at a separating point is ε←ε−μ L(ε)\bepsilon \leftarrow \bepsilon - \mu\,\mathcal{L}(\bepsilon)ε←ε−μL(ε), where L\mathcal{L}L is the linear map of the proof of Theorem 7.2定理 7.2. Its eigenvalues ϑ\varthetaϑ are the numbers 1+mi1 + m_i1+mi​ and the eigenvalues of the pair matrices in (7.9), all real. The error contracts if and only if ∣1−μϑ∣<1|1 - \mu\vartheta| < 1∣1−μϑ∣<1 for every ϑ\varthetaϑ, that is, 0<μ<2/ϑmax⁡0 < \mu < 2/\vartheta_{\max}0<μ<2/ϑmax​ when all ϑ>0\vartheta > 0ϑ>0. For two Laplace sources and φ=tanh⁡\varphi = \tanhφ=tanh the eigenvalues are 2.4142.4142.414, 1.2141.2141.214 (twice) and 0.4140.4140.414: any μ<0.83\mu < 0.83μ<0.83 converges locally, and with μ=0.5\mu = 0.5μ=0.5 the slowest mode shrinks by the factor 1−0.5×0.414≈0.791 - 0.5 \times 0.414 \approx 0.791−0.5×0.414≈0.79 per iteration. By equivariance these numbers do not depend on A\bAA.

批量迭代。步长固定时，(7.5) 是一个不动点迭代，它在分离点处的线性化为 ε←ε−μ L(ε)\bepsilon \leftarrow \bepsilon - \mu\,\mathcal{L}(\bepsilon)ε←ε−μL(ε)，其中 L\mathcal{L}L 是Theorem 7.2定理 7.2证明中的线性映射。它的特征值 ϑ\varthetaϑ 是各个 1+mi1 + m_i1+mi​ 以及 (7.9) 中各源对矩阵的特征值，全是实数。误差收缩当且仅当对每个 ϑ\varthetaϑ 都有 ∣1−μϑ∣<1|1 - \mu\vartheta| < 1∣1−μϑ∣<1；当所有 ϑ>0\vartheta > 0ϑ>0 时，即 0<μ<2/ϑmax⁡0 < \mu < 2/\vartheta_{\max}0<μ<2/ϑmax​。对两个拉普拉斯源和 φ=tanh⁡\varphi = \tanhφ=tanh，特征值为 2.4142.4142.414、1.2141.2141.214（二重）和 0.4140.4140.414：任何 μ<0.83\mu < 0.83μ<0.83 都局部收敛；取 μ=0.5\mu = 0.5μ=0.5 时，最慢的模态每次迭代缩小为原来的 1−0.5×0.414≈0.791 - 0.5 \times 0.414 \approx 0.791−0.5×0.414≈0.79 倍。由等变性，这些数都与 A\bAA 无关。

Online learning. The online rule updates W\bWW with one sample, or a small block, at a time. With a constant step size W\bWW does not converge; it keeps fluctuating around the separating point, with a spread that shrinks as μ\muμ decreases. The mean flow (7.7) describes the average motion, so the stability conditions of Theorem 7.2定理 7.2 decide which points the online algorithm can hover around. Step sizes that decrease with ∑tμt=∞\sum_t\mu_t = \infty∑t​μt​=∞ and ∑tμt2<∞\sum_t\mu_t^2 < \infty∑t​μt2​<∞, as in stochastic approximation (Robbins & Monro, 1951), control accumulated noise under additional regularity and stability conditions. They do not alone guarantee convergence: bounded iterates, suitable noise moments and a basin of attraction are also needed, and a stable unwanted root can still be reached. Online learning suits data that arrive as a stream or do not fit in memory, and it can track a mixing matrix that drifts slowly; for a fixed data set, batch or block updates are simpler to tune.

在线学习。在线规则每次只用一个样本（或一个小数据块）更新 W\bWW。步长固定时 W\bWW 不会收敛，而是在分离点附近持续波动，波动幅度随 μ\muμ 减小而减小。平均流 (7.7) 描述的是平均运动，所以在线算法能在哪些点附近徘徊，同样由Theorem 7.2定理 7.2的稳定性条件决定。像随机逼近（Robbins & Monro, 1951）那样取满足 ∑tμt=∞\sum_t\mu_t = \infty∑t​μt​=∞ 且 ∑tμt2<∞\sum_t\mu_t^2 < \infty∑t​μt2​<∞ 的递减步长，在附加的正则性与稳定性条件下可控制累积噪声；仅靠这两个级数条件并不能保证收敛，还需要迭代有界、适当的噪声矩条件与吸引域，并且算法仍可能到达稳定但不需要的根。在线学习适合以数据流形式到达或内存放不下的数据，也能跟踪缓慢漂移的混合矩阵；对于固定的数据集，批量或分块更新更容易调参。

EASI. Cardoso and Laheld (1996) proposed a serial algorithm that whitens and rotates at the same time, so that no separate whitening step is needed:

EASI。Cardoso 与 Laheld（1996）提出了一种同时完成白化与旋转的串行算法，因而不需要单独的白化步骤：

W←W−μt[yy⊤−I+g(y) y⊤−y g(y)⊤]W,y=Wx(t).(7.12)\bW \leftarrow \bW - \mu_t\bigl[\by\by^\top - \bI + \mathbf{g}(\by)\,\by^\top - \by\,\mathbf{g}(\by)^\top\bigr]\bW, \qquad \by = \bW\bx(t).\tag{7.12}W←W−μt​[yy⊤−I+g(y)y⊤−yg(y)⊤]W,y=Wx(t).(7.12)

The symmetric part yy⊤−I\by\by^\top - \bIyy⊤−I pushes the output covariance toward I\bII; the skew-symmetric part g(y)y⊤−y g(y)⊤\mathbf{g}(\by)\by^\top - \by\,\mathbf{g}(\by)^\topg(y)y⊤−yg(y)⊤ leaves the output covariance unchanged to first order when that covariance is I\bII, and drives the rotation, with equilibrium E[gi(yi)yj]=E[yigj(yj)]\E[g_i(y_i)y_j] = \E[y_ig_j(y_j)]E[gi​(yi​)yj​]=E[yi​gj​(yj​)]. and unstable if λi+λj>0\lambda_i + \lambda_j > 0λi​+λj​>0 for some pair (Exercise 7.5习题 7.5). For g(y)=y3g(y) = y^3g(y)=y3, λi=κi\lambda_i = \kappa_iλi​=κi​, so EASI with the cubic nonlinearity separates pairs whose kurtoses sum to a negative number; for g=tanh⁡g = \tanhg=tanh, λ=−0.148\lambda = -0.148λ=−0.148 for a Laplace source and +0.126+0.126+0.126 for a uniform one. The same quantity E[s g(s)−g′(s)]\E[s\,g(s) - g'(s)]E[sg(s)−g′(s)] governs FastICA in the next chapter.

若某一对满足 λi+λj>0\lambda_i + \lambda_j > 0λi​+λj​>0，则不稳定（Exercise 7.5习题 7.5）。对 g(y)=y3g(y) = y^3g(y)=y3，λi=κi\lambda_i = \kappa_iλi​=κi​，所以采用三次非线性的 EASI 能分离峭度之和为负的源对；对 g=tanh⁡g = \tanhg=tanh，拉普拉斯源的 λ=−0.148\lambda = -0.148λ=−0.148，均匀源的 λ=+0.126\lambda = +0.126λ=+0.126。同一个量 E[s g(s)−g′(s)]\E[s\,g(s) - g'(s)]E[sg(s)−g′(s)] 也支配着下一章的 FastICA。

7.9 Numerical safeguards and stopping rules数值保护与停止准则

An ascent direction does not guarantee an ascent for every finite step. Set H=I−E^[φ(y)y⊤]\bH=\bI-\hat\E[\bphi(\by)\by^\top]H=I−E^[φ(y)y⊤], so Wnew=(I+μH)W\bW_{\rm new}=(\bI+\mu\bH)\bWWnew​=(I+μH)W. The condition μ∥H∥2<1\mu\|\bH\|_2<1μ∥H∥2​<1 is sufficient for invertibility, but not objective improvement. In batch learning with a fixed differentiable source model, backtracking can reduce μ\muμ until the candidate is nonsingular, all values are finite and the sample likelihood increases. Compute log⁡∣det⁡W∣\log|\det\bW|log∣detW∣ with slogdet and log⁡cosh⁡u\log\cosh ulogcoshu as ∣u∣+log⁡(1+e−2∣u∣)−log⁡2|u|+\log(1+e^{-2|u|})-\log2∣u∣+log(1+e−2∣u∣)−log2. Reject a singular or nonfinite candidate.

上升方向不保证任意有限步长都使目标上升。记 H=I−E^[φ(y)y⊤]\bH=\bI-\hat\E[\bphi(\by)\by^\top]H=I−E^[φ(y)y⊤]，则 Wnew=(I+μH)W\bW_{\rm new}=(\bI+\mu\bH)\bWWnew​=(I+μH)W。μ∥H∥2<1\mu\|\bH\|_2<1μ∥H∥2​<1 是可逆性的充分条件，却不保证目标改善。对固定可微源模型的批量学习，可回溯减小 μ\muμ，直到候选矩阵非奇异、所有数值有限且样本似然上升。用 slogdet 计算 log⁡∣det⁡W∣\log|\det\bW|log∣detW∣，用 ∣u∣+log⁡(1+e−2∣u∣)−log⁡2|u|+\log(1+e^{-2|u|})-\log2∣u∣+log(1+e−2∣u∣)−log2 计算 log⁡cosh⁡u\log\cosh ulogcoshu。应拒绝奇异或非有限的候选值。

A small increment may indicate stationarity or merely a tiny step size. Record the relative increment ∥ΔW W−1∥F=μ∥H∥F\|\Delta\bW\,\bW^{-1}\|_F=\mu\|\bH\|_F∥ΔWW−1∥F​=μ∥H∥F​, the residual ∥H∥F\|\bH\|_F∥H∥F​, objective changes and the iteration limit separately. An estimate returned at the limit must be labelled unconverged. In minibatch learning assess a residual on a larger fixed block because individual updates are noisy. Save the training mean: new data must be transformed as W(xnew−xˉtrain)\bW(\bx_{\rm new}-\bar\bx_{\rm train})W(xnew​−xˉtrain​).

增量小可能表示已接近驻点，也可能只是步长过小。应分别记录相对增量 ∥ΔW W−1∥F=μ∥H∥F\|\Delta\bW\,\bW^{-1}\|_F=\mu\|\bH\|_F∥ΔWW−1∥F​=μ∥H∥F​、残差 ∥H∥F\|\bH\|_F∥H∥F​、目标变化与迭代次数上限。达到上限后的结果应标明未收敛。小批量学习的单次更新含噪，应在较大的固定数据块上评价残差。还应保存训练均值：新数据的变换为 W(xnew−xˉtrain)\bW(\bx_{\rm new}-\bar\bx_{\rm train})W(xnew​−xˉtrain​)。

Extended Infomax changes its nonlinearity when a sign switches, so the fixed-objective monotonicity argument cannot be applied automatically. Estimate switching statistics on adequate blocks, use a tolerance near zero and record switches. A Gaussian or nearly Gaussian output gives a zero or uncertain statistic; the theorem asserts local stability for a self-consistent separating point with nonzero switching statistics, not global convergence of a switching algorithm. The sub-Gaussian mixture above is also not genuinely bimodal: its score y−tanh⁡yy-\tanh yy−tanhy is positive for y>0y>0y>0, so the density has a single, flat-topped mode at zero.

扩展 Infomax 在符号切换时改变非线性函数，不能自动套用固定目标的单调性论证。应在足够大的数据块上估计切换统计量，在零附近设置容差并记录切换。高斯或近高斯输出会给出为零或难以确定的统计量；定理保证的是切换统计量非零、符号自洽的分离点附近的局部稳定性，不是整个切换算法的全局收敛。上面的亚高斯混合密度也并非真正双峰：对 y>0y>0y>0，其得分 y−tanh⁡yy-\tanh yy−tanhy 为正，因此密度在零处只有一个平顶峰。

The right-invariant metric used in the derivation is a chosen geometry on invertible matrices. It does not mean that the full statistical Fisher information is the identity: the source-dependent Fisher blocks appear in (10.9). Also, centering and fitting a bias are distinct operations. For y=Wx+b\by=\bW\bx+\mathbf by=Wx+b, a stationary fitted bias requires E[φ(y)]=0\E[\bphi(\by)]=\bzeroE[φ(y)]=0; E[x]=0\E[\bx]=\bzeroE[x]=0 alone does not imply this for skewed sources and a mismatched symmetric density. The centered, bias-free model used in this chapter is an explicit modeling choice.

推导中的右不变度量是可逆矩阵空间上的一种几何选择，并不表示完整的统计 Fisher 信息等于单位阵；依赖源分布的 Fisher 分块见(10.9)。此外，中心化与拟合偏置是两种不同操作。对 y=Wx+b\by=\bW\bx+\mathbf by=Wx+b，偏置的驻点条件是 E[φ(y)]=0\E[\bphi(\by)]=\bzeroE[φ(y)]=0；对偏斜源和失配的对称密度，E[x]=0\E[\bx]=\bzeroE[x]=0 本身不推出这一条件。本章采用已中心化、无偏置的模型，是明确的建模选择。

Key points

本章要点

  • The relative or natural gradient (I−E[φ(y)y⊤])W(\bI - \E[\bphi(\by)\by^\top])\bW(I−E[φ(y)y⊤])W is the ordinary gradient multiplied on the right by W⊤W\bW^\top\bWW⊤W. It is the steepest-ascent direction for the metric ∥dW W−1∥F\|d\bW\,\bW^{-1}\|_F∥dWW−1∥F​ and needs no matrix inversion.
  • Natural-gradient algorithms are equivariant: in terms of the global matrix P=WA\bP = \bW\bAP=WA they do not depend on A\bAA, so their exact relative iterations agree under corresponding transformed initializations; finite-precision conditioning and the choice of initialization still matter.
  • When the scalar scale equations are solvable and the expectations exist, separating points solve the estimating equations; whether they attract the algorithm depends on kik_iki​, mim_imi​ and σi2\sigma_i^2σi2​ through conditions on single sources and pairs. With the true scores they always hold when at most one source is Gaussian.
  • Infomax is maximum likelihood with a logistic source model, φ(y)=tanh⁡(y/2)\varphi(y) = \tanh(y/2)φ(y)=tanh(y/2); its separating points are stable for typical super-Gaussian sources (Laplace, logistic) but not, for example, for a pair of uniform sources. Extended Infomax switches each output between a super- and a sub-Gaussian model by a rule that is the stability condition itself.
  • Batch iterations converge locally for 0<μ<2/ϑmax⁡0 < \mu < 2/\vartheta_{\max}0<μ<2/ϑmax​, where ϑmax⁡\vartheta_{\max}ϑmax​ is the largest eigenvalue of the linearization; online updates need decreasing step sizes to settle. EASI whitens and separates in one equivariant serial update and is stable when λi+λj<0\lambda_i + \lambda_j < 0λi​+λj​<0 for all pairs.
  • 相对梯度（自然梯度）(I−E[φ(y)y⊤])W(\bI - \E[\bphi(\by)\by^\top])\bW(I−E[φ(y)y⊤])W 就是普通梯度右乘 W⊤W\bW^\top\bWW⊤W。它是度量 ∥dW W−1∥F\|d\bW\,\bW^{-1}\|_F∥dWW−1∥F​ 下的最速上升方向，不需要矩阵求逆。
  • 自然梯度算法是等变的：用全局矩阵 P=WA\bP = \bW\bAP=WA 表示时它们与 A\bAA 无关，在相应变换的初值下，其精确相对迭代一致；有限精度下的条件数与初值选择仍然重要。
  • 当标量尺度方程可解且期望存在时，分离点满足估计方程；它们能否吸引算法，取决于 kik_iki​、mim_imi​ 和 σi2\sigma_i^2σi2​，条件只涉及单个源和源对。使用真实得分函数时，只要至多一个源是高斯的，这些条件总成立。
  • Infomax 是以 logistic 分布为源模型的最大似然，φ(y)=tanh⁡(y/2)\varphi(y) = \tanh(y/2)φ(y)=tanh(y/2)；它的分离点对常见的超高斯源（拉普拉斯、logistic）是稳定的，但对一对均匀源等情形则不稳定。扩展 Infomax 按一条规则让每个输出在超高斯与亚高斯模型之间切换，而这条规则正是稳定性条件本身。
  • 批量迭代在 0<μ<2/ϑmax⁡0 < \mu < 2/\vartheta_{\max}0<μ<2/ϑmax​ 时局部收敛（ϑmax⁡\vartheta_{\max}ϑmax​ 为线性化的最大特征值）；在线更新需要递减步长才能稳定下来。EASI 用一个等变的串行更新同时完成白化与分离，当所有源对满足 λi+λj<0\lambda_i + \lambda_j < 0λi​+λj​<0 时稳定。

Before the exercises

开始习题前

  • Form the nonlinear average, subtract it from identity, then apply the relative update.
  • Monitor the residual as well as the parameter increment.
  • Check source-model choice and step size before trusting a stopping signal.
  • 先计算非线性平均，再用单位阵减去它，最后作相对更新。
  • 同时监测残差与参数增量。
  • 相信停止信号前，先检查源模型选择与步长。

Start with the logistic-score exercise, then parts (a) and (b) of the gradient exercise. Return to the cubic stability and EASI exercises after the local-stability section.

先做logistic 得分习题，再做梯度习题的（a）（b）；读完局部稳定性一节后，再回到三次非线性稳定性与 EASI 习题。

Exercise 7.1习题 7.1 basic基础

Let g(u)=1/(1+e−u)g(u) = 1/(1 + e^{-u})g(u)=1/(1+e−u). (a) Show that g′=g(1−g)g' = g(1 - g)g′=g(1−g). (b) Show that the score of the logistic density g′g'g′ is 2g−12g - 12g−1, and that 2g(u)−1=tanh⁡(u/2)2g(u) - 1 = \tanh(u/2)2g(u)−1=tanh(u/2). (c) Conclude that the term 1−2g(y)\mathbf{1} - 2\mathbf{g}(\by)1−2g(y) in Bell and Sejnowski's gradient equals −φ(y)-\bphi(\by)−φ(y) for the logistic model.

设 g(u)=1/(1+e−u)g(u) = 1/(1 + e^{-u})g(u)=1/(1+e−u)。（a）证明 g′=g(1−g)g' = g(1 - g)g′=g(1−g)。（b）证明 logistic 密度 g′g'g′ 的得分函数为 2g−12g - 12g−1，且 2g(u)−1=tanh⁡(u/2)2g(u) - 1 = \tanh(u/2)2g(u)−1=tanh(u/2)。（c）由此说明，对 logistic 模型，Bell 与 Sejnowski 梯度中的项 1−2g(y)\mathbf{1} - 2\mathbf{g}(\by)1−2g(y) 等于 −φ(y)-\bphi(\by)−φ(y)。

(b) log⁡g′=log⁡g+log⁡(1−g)\log g' = \log g + \log(1 - g)logg′=logg+log(1−g), so (log⁡g′)′=g′/g−g′/(1−g)=(1−g)−g=1−2g(\log g')' = g'/g - g'/(1 - g) = (1 - g) - g = 1 - 2g(logg′)′=g′/g−g′/(1−g)=(1−g)−g=1−2g, and the score is −(log⁡g′)′=2g−1-(\log g')' = 2g - 1−(logg′)′=2g−1. Multiplying numerator and denominator by eu/2e^{u/2}eu/2, 2g(u)−1=1−e−u1+e−u=eu/2−e−u/2eu/2+e−u/2=tanh⁡(u/2)2g(u) - 1 = \frac{1 - e^{-u}}{1 + e^{-u}} = \frac{e^{u/2} - e^{-u/2}}{e^{u/2} + e^{-u/2}} = \tanh(u/2)2g(u)−1=1+e−u1−e−u​=eu/2+e−u/2eu/2−e−u/2​=tanh(u/2). (c) Componentwise, 1−2g(yi)=−(2g(yi)−1)=−φ(yi)1 - 2g(y_i) = -(2g(y_i) - 1) = -\varphi(y_i)1−2g(yi​)=−(2g(yi​)−1)=−φ(yi​), so W−⊤+E[(1−2g(y))x⊤]=W−⊤−E[φ(y)x⊤]\bW^{-\top} + \E[(\mathbf{1} - 2\mathbf{g}(\by))\bx^\top] = \bW^{-\top} - \E[\bphi(\by)\bx^\top]W−⊤+E[(1−2g(y))x⊤]=W−⊤−E[φ(y)x⊤], which is (7.2).

（a）g′(u)=e−u/(1+e−u)2=11+e−u⋅e−u1+e−u=g(u) (1−g(u))g'(u) = e^{-u}/(1 + e^{-u})^2 = \frac{1}{1 + e^{-u}}\cdot\frac{e^{-u}}{1 + e^{-u}} = g(u)\,(1 - g(u))g′(u)=e−u/(1+e−u)2=1+e−u1​⋅1+e−ue−u​=g(u)(1−g(u))。（b）log⁡g′=log⁡g+log⁡(1−g)\log g' = \log g + \log(1 - g)logg′=logg+log(1−g)，所以 (log⁡g′)′=g′/g−g′/(1−g)=(1−g)−g=1−2g(\log g')' = g'/g - g'/(1 - g) = (1 - g) - g = 1 - 2g(logg′)′=g′/g−g′/(1−g)=(1−g)−g=1−2g，得分函数为 −(log⁡g′)′=2g−1-(\log g')' = 2g - 1−(logg′)′=2g−1。分子分母同乘 eu/2e^{u/2}eu/2，得 2g(u)−1=1−e−u1+e−u=eu/2−e−u/2eu/2+e−u/2=tanh⁡(u/2)2g(u) - 1 = \frac{1 - e^{-u}}{1 + e^{-u}} = \frac{e^{u/2} - e^{-u/2}}{e^{u/2} + e^{-u/2}} = \tanh(u/2)2g(u)−1=1+e−u1−e−u​=eu/2+e−u/2eu/2−e−u/2​=tanh(u/2)。（c）逐分量地，1−2g(yi)=−(2g(yi)−1)=−φ(yi)1 - 2g(y_i) = -(2g(y_i) - 1) = -\varphi(y_i)1−2g(yi​)=−(2g(yi​)−1)=−φ(yi​)，所以 W−⊤+E[(1−2g(y))x⊤]=W−⊤−E[φ(y)x⊤]\bW^{-\top} + \E[(\mathbf{1} - 2\mathbf{g}(\by))\bx^\top] = \bW^{-\top} - \E[\bphi(\by)\bx^\top]W−⊤+E[(1−2g(y))x⊤]=W−⊤−E[φ(y)x⊤]，这正是 (7.2)。

Exercise 7.3习题 7.3 intermediate进阶

(a) Derive (7.3) from (7.2). (b) Show that multiplying the ordinary gradient on the right by W⊤W\bW^\top\bWW⊤W gives an update of P\bPP in which A\bAA does not appear. (c) Show that for orthogonal A\bAA the ordinary-gradient recursion for P\bPP does not depend on A\bAA either. Why does this not make plain gradient ascent equivariant?

（a）由 (7.2) 推出 (7.3)。（b）证明把普通梯度右乘 W⊤W\bW^\top\bWW⊤W 后，P\bPP 的更新中不再出现 A\bAA。（c）证明当 A\bAA 为正交矩阵时，普通梯度关于 P\bPP 的递推同样与 A\bAA 无关。为什么这并不意味着普通梯度上升是等变的？
